purpose: py_internal.cc_helper.is_valid_shared_library_artifact(shared_library) (builtins_bzl/common/python/py_internal.bzl:101-131, `_is_valid_shared_library_artifact` / `_is_versioned_shared_library_extension_valid`): `extension` in [so, dll, dylib, pyd, wasm], else the basename's last `.so.`/`.dylib.` split with a non-empty name and version whose `.`-parts start with an ASCII digit and continue with [a-zA-Z0-9_]; duck-typed fields; the `def`'s binding and evaluation errors.
